body:
Dear all, I'm trying to design some matmul kernels between sparse matrices.

The kernel deals with matmul between a 3-d and a 2-d tensor (shaped [B, M, K] and [K, N]), where some rows of the 3-d tensor (i.e., dim M) is not required in matmul computation.

This kernel failed to be lowered from ttgir to llir in this line:
https://github.com/triton-lang/triton/blob/b933f0fafe735ac21b1aa6f507336b0cafcc1bbb/python/triton/compiler/compiler.py#L288

Triton git hash: 757b6a61e7df814ba806f498f8bb3160f84b120c
LLVM git hash: 10dc3a8e916d73291269e5e2b82dd22681489aa1
Device: A100
CUDA: 12.1

Kernel:
```python
import triton
import triton.language as tl

@triton.runtime.autotuner.autotune(
...
)
@triton.heuristics(
    {
        "EVEN_K": lambda args: args["K"] % (args["BLOCK_K"] * args["SPLIT_K"]) == 0,
    }
)
@triton.jit
def _sparse_matmul(
    X,
    W,
    Y,
    off_m,
    B,
    M,
    N,
    K,
    stride_xb,
    stride_xm,
    stride_xk,
    stride_wk,
    stride_wn,
    stride_yb,
    stride_ym,
    stride_yn,
    stride_om,
    BLOCK_B: tl.constexpr,
    BLOCK_M: tl.constexpr,
    BLOCK_N: tl.constexpr,
    BLOCK_K: tl.constexpr,
    GROUP_M: tl.constexpr,
    SPLIT_K: tl.constexpr,
    EVEN_K: tl.constexpr,
    AB_DTYPE: tl.constexpr,
    acc_dtype: tl.constexpr,
    input_precision: tl.constexpr,
    fp8_fast_accum: tl.constexpr,
):
    # X * W => Y
    pid = tl.program_id(0)
    pid_k = tl.program_id(1)

    grid_b = tl.cdiv(B, BLOCK_B)
    pid_ = pid // grid_b
    pid_b = pid % grid_b

    grid_m = tl.cdiv(M, BLOCK_M)
    width = GROUP_M * tl.cdiv(N, BLOCK_N)
    group_id = pid_ // width
    group_size = min(grid_m - group_id * GROUP_M, GROUP_M)

    pid_m = group_id * GROUP_M + (pid_ % group_size)
    pid_n = (pid_ % width) // (group_size)

    r_b = (pid_b * BLOCK_B + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_B)) % B
    r_m = (pid_m * BLOCK_M + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_M)) % M
    r_n = (pid_n * BLOCK_N + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_N)) % N
    r_k = (pid_k * BLOCK_K + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_K)) % K

    tl.max_contiguous(tl.multiple_of(r_b, BLOCK_B), BLOCK_B)
    tl.max_contiguous(tl.multiple_of(r_m, BLOCK_M), BLOCK_M)
    tl.max_contiguous(tl.multiple_of(r_n, BLOCK_N), BLOCK_N)
    tl.max_contiguous(tl.multiple_of(r_k, BLOCK_K), BLOCK_K)

    o_m = tl.load(off_m + r_m * stride_om, mask=r_m < M)

    X_ = (
        X
        + r_b[:, None, None] * stride_xb
        + o_m[None, :, None] * stride_xm
        + r_k[None, None, :] * stride_xk
    )
    W_ = W + r_k[:, None] * stride_wk + r_n[None, :] * stride_wn
    Y_ = (
        Y
        + r_b[:, None, None] * stride_yb
        + o_m[None, :, None] * stride_ym
        + r_n[None, None, :] * stride_yn
    )
    acc = tl.zeros((BLOCK_B, BLOCK_M, BLOCK_N), dtype=acc_dtype)
    x_0 = tl.zeros((1, 1, 1), dtype=Y.dtype.element_ty)
    w_0 = tl.zeros((1, 1), dtype=Y.dtype.element_ty)
    for k in tl.range(0, tl.cdiv(K, BLOCK_K * SPLIT_K)):
        mask_x = (
            (r_b[:, None, None] < B)
            & (r_m[None, :, None] < M)
            & (r_k[None, None, :] < K - k * (BLOCK_K * SPLIT_K))
        )
        mask_w = (r_k[:, None] < K - k * (BLOCK_K * SPLIT_K)) & (r_n[None, :] < N)
        x = tl.load(X_, mask=mask_x, other=x_0)
        w = tl.load(W_, mask=mask_w, other=w_0)

        if AB_DTYPE is not None:
            x = tl.cast(x, AB_DTYPE)
            w = tl.cast(w, AB_DTYPE)

        w = tl.expand_dims(w, 0)
        w = tl.broadcast_to(w, (BLOCK_B, BLOCK_K, BLOCK_N))
        if fp8_fast_accum:
            acc = tl.dot(x, w, acc, out_dtype=acc_dtype, input_precision=input_precision)
        else:
            acc += tl.dot(x, w, out_dtype=acc_dtype, input_precision=input_precision)

        r_k += BLOCK_K * SPLIT_K
        X_ += BLOCK_K * SPLIT_K * stride_xk
        W_ += BLOCK_K * SPLIT_K * stride_wk

    acc = tl.cast(acc, Y.dtype.element_ty)
    mask = (r_b[:, None, None] < B) & (r_m[None, :, None] < M) & (r_n[None, None, :] < N)
    if SPLIT_K == 1:
        tl.store(Y_, acc, mask=mask)
    else:
        tl.atomic_add(Y_, acc, mask=mask)

```

```python

N, K = W.shape

    META["SPLIT_K"],

    W,

    X.stride(0),
    X.stride(1),
    X.stride(2),
    W.stride(0),
    W.stride(1),
    Y.stride(0),
    Y.stride(1),
    Y.stride(2),
    off_m.stride(0),
    acc_dtype=tl.float16,
    input_precision=tl.float16,
    fp8_fast_accum=True,
    GROUP_M=8,
    AB_DTYPE=tl.float16,
)
```
